To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the induced colchiploids have been found to be superior to the diploids in terms of all the determinate plant parts, cell size, pollen and seed size.
induced autotetraploid H. muticus has been developed with high pollen and ovule fertility, and the increase in alkaloid yield per plant has been achieved.
the tetraploidy in H. muticus was achieved through ovary culture and the colchiploidy was confirmed by cytological and morphological analysis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new crop variety of H. muticus with enhanced production potential.
the production of autotetraploid plants of Hyoscyamus, a medicinal plant, through colchicine-induced polyploidy.
the development of colchiploids of H. muticus with high pollen and embryo fertility and their use for genetic improvement of the crop.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the colchiploidy has been successfully induced in Hyoscyamus and the resulting colchicloids have been found to be superior to the corresponding diploid parents in most of the economically important traits.
the tetraploids have been successfully produced and are superior to the diploids in all the important economic characters.
the tetraploid plants of H. muticus are superior to the diploid plants with respect to the morphological, cytological and alkaloid characteristics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the tetraploid plants have a higher yield potential and are more suitable for cultivation than the diploid plants.
the induced tetraploids of Hyoscyamus have been successfully developed and the improvement in alkaloid content along with other characters has been achieved through the induction of autopolyploidy.
we have been able to develop a high yielding, vigorous and fertile autotetraploid of Hyoscyamus with increased content of alkaloids.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the induced tetraploids have the advantage of increasing the economic product — total alkaloids — by about 1.5 fold, and the increase in the seed fertility is an added advantage.
the colchiploidy can be used to enhance the production potential of a medicinally important plant.
the colchiploidy technique is an excellent tool for the genetic improvement of economically important medicinal plants.
